newsitem.title: FRANCE: Legrand H1 net profit falls 3.2 pct. [CORRECTED 18:57 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Legrand H1 net profit falls 3.2 pct. [CORRECTED 18:57 GMT]

text.p: (Figures in millions of French francs unless stated)

Note - French electrical retailer Legrand said in a statement that on a constant structure and exchange rate basis sales rose 1.7 percent. International sales rose 4.4 percent while domestic sales fell 1.8 percent.
(Company corrects rate of increase of international sales).

The company said it had reinforced its position in Latin America with the purchase of Luminex, the Colombian leader in electronic equipment which has turnover of 200 million francs in Colombia, Brazil and in Mexico.
